# Deltempo

> Deltempo is a fast, portable, open-source Windows cleaner, app uninstaller, and NT memory optimizer for Windows 10 and 11. Zero telemetry, 100% local, MIT licensed.

- [Official Website](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/): Primary homepage, interactive simulator, and downloads
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Beso1227/Deltempo): Source code, issues, and community contributions
- [Download](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/download/): Standalone executable and WinGet installation
- [Documentation](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/docs/): Technical guide to 25+ scopes, safety tiers, and CLI commands
- [FAQ](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/faq/): Common questions on safety, GPU caches, NT memory, and app uninstallation
- [Changelog](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/changelog/): Release notes and version history (including v1.7.0)

## Overview
Deltempo safely purges disposable system, developer, and browser caches, recovers gigabytes of disk space, thoroughly uninstalls desktop programs with leftover cleanup, provides startup intelligence, and trims inactive Windows memory working sets with zero telemetry.
Package identifier for Microsoft WinGet: `winget install Beso1227.Deltempo`

## Core Capabilities
- **25+ Cleaning Scopes**: System temp, driver installers, shader caches, browser caches, dev artifacts (NuGet, npm, pip, Cargo, Gradle), and crash dumps.
- **Deep Root App Uninstaller (v1.7.0)**: Powered by BCU engine; performs silent bulk removals, registry and AppData leftover sweeps, and force-removals of corrupt/broken software.
- **Application & Startup Intelligence**: Answers "Will anything go wrong if I disable or uninstall this?" with 3-tier verdicts (SafeToDisable, CautionNeeded, EssentialKeep), offline heuristics, and multi-provider AI support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio).
- **Process Manager with Native Icons**: Real-time process inspection with live high-DPI icon extraction from running executables.
- **Chris Titus Tech WinUtil (CTT) 1-Click Launcher**: Built-in direct execution of the renowned Windows utility.
- **Native NT Memory Optimizer**: Standby list flushes and working set trims via `NtSetSystemInformation` and `EmptyWorkingSet`.
- **Zero Telemetry**: All operations run locally; completely free and open-source under the MIT license.
